subject: Goblin Warrior
picture: A small goblin warrior in a narrow stone dungeon corridor. One foot is planted on the floor. The other foot strikes the body of a hanging lantern and knocks that lantern off its wall hook, so the lantern is tipping in the air. He holds a crude sword in one hand and a small round shield in the other hand. He has big pointed ears and a long nose. The corridor has a stone ceiling, large block walls, large floor slabs, one wooden crate, and one fallen stone. The drawing reaches all four edges.
